V="ssh -i /c/Users/Георгий/.ssh/id_rsa -o UserKnownHostsFile=/c/Users/Георгий/.ssh/known_hosts -o BatchMode=yes root@13.140.29.171"; $V 'mkdir -p /opt/alpha-compute/tk015 && cat > /opt/alpha-compute/tk015/vps-d20.sh <<"EOF"
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# TK-015: кэш подходов D20 (бинарник T-28 16f0a80 = bin/alpha-t28, md5 4a8038dc…) для эпох янв–июн на VPS, бинлоги —
# с ящика /mnt/sb (sshfs ro); так же, как день epoch-box-prep.sh на деке, без режима (его досчитывает дека после забора).
#   vps-d20.sh <эпоха> <сутки…>   → /opt/alpha-compute/tk015/<эпоха>/study/approaches/D20/<сутки>/ + .vps-done
set -uo pipefail
E="$1"; shift; SB=/mnt/sb/alpha/epochs/$E/root; H=/opt/alpha-compute/tk015/$E; BIN=/opt/alpha-compute/bin/alpha-t28
mountpoint -q /mnt/sb || { echo "ящик не смонтирован"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$H"; cd "$H" || exit 1
for day in "$@"; do
  out="study/approaches/D20/$day"; [ -f "$out/.vps-done" ] && { echo "$day уже"; continue; }
  dir="study/root-$day"; rm -rf "$dir" "$out"; mkdir -p "$dir" "$out" "study/touches/$day"
  for f in "$SB"/*-"$day".binlog "$SB"/*-"$day"-p*.binlog "$SB/instruments.csv"; do [ -e "$f" ] && ln -s "$f" "$dir/"; done
  echo '"'"'{"start_hour_utc":0,"closed":true,"binlog_files":[]}'"'"' > "$dir/session.json"
  grep -aE "^verify: [A-Z0-9]+ status=(ok|fail)" "$SB/verify-logs/$day.log" | while read -r _ sym st _; do echo "${st#status=}" > "$dir/verify-$sym.status"; done
  grep -l "^ok$" "$dir"/verify-*.status | xargs -n1 basename | sed "s/^verify-//; s/\.status$//" > "study/touches/$day/symbols.txt"
  n=$(wc -l < "study/touches/$day/symbols.txt"); t0=$(date +%s)
  xargs -r -P "${JOBS:-4}" -I{} nice -n 15 bash -c "$BIN lob touches --root $dir --symbol {} --h3-mode notional --h3-usd 10000 --approach-bps 20 --out $out/touches-{}.csv > $out/{}.log 2>&1 || echo {} >> $out/failed.txt" < "study/touches/$day/symbols.txt"
  files=$(ls "$out"/approaches-*.csv 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  [ "$files" -ge "$n" ] && [ ! -f "$out/failed.txt" ] && touch "$out/.vps-done"
  echo "== $(date -u +%FT%TZ) $E $day: ok-монет $n, файлов подходов $files, $(( $(date +%s)-t0 )) с"
done
EOF
chmod +x /opt/alpha-compute/tk015/vps-d20.sh; grep -c "" /opt/alpha-compute/tk015/vps-d20.sh; sed -n 13p /opt/alpha-compute/tk015/vps-d20.sh'
